name: os
line: How I make product calls. Fourteen rules and 56 test cases; the last run passed 111 of 168.
problem: My product calls lived in my head, so nobody could check them or argue with them.
call: Write the rules down and test them like code, against real cases.
result: Each run ranks the weakest rules, so I know which ones to fix first.

name: High Leverage Research
line: An AI investment committee. Nothing publishes until I sign it.
problem: AI research sounds equally confident whether it is right or wrong.
call: Run it as a committee with dissent, and keep the final vote human.

name: Midwatch
line: Three AI agents plan, build and review. I decide what ships.
problem: Agents that write code will also ship it if nobody stops them.
call: Split planning, building and review across three agents, and keep the ship decision.
